invite.title: Join an invitation
invite.login_hint: Log in or create an account to view and accept this invitation.
invite.invalid_hint: The invitation has expired or has been revoked.

login.title: Login
login.passkey_unsupported: Passkeys are unavailable in this browser. Try a supported browser or another sign-in method.
login.passkey_unregistered: No passkey is available for this email address. Sign in another way and register a passkey in Settings.
login.passkey_failed: Passkey sign-in failed. Check your connection and passkey, then try again.
login.passkey_profile_failed: Your account information could not be loaded. Please sign in again.
login.account_locked_detail: Suspicious activity may have been detected. Please try again in 30 minutes.
login.email_not_verified_detail: Please open the link in the verification email we sent at sign-up, then log in again.

register.title: Create Account
register.privacy_consent_required: You must agree to the Privacy Policy
register.terms_consent_required: You must agree to the Terms of Service

password_reset.title: Password Reset
password_reset.email_sent: Password reset email has been sent

session_notice.password_changed: Your password has been changed. Please log in again for security.
session_notice.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.

auth.beta_invite_required_desc: During the beta period, please register via an invitation link.
auth.beta_invite_invalid_desc: The invitation code is invalid or not eligible for the beta.

oauth.conflict_message: This email is already registered. Please check your email.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.subtitle_totp: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app
mfa.subtitle_email: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your registered email address
mfa.subtitle_email_unsent: Press "Send a code by email" and a 6-digit code will be sent to your registered email address
mfa.subtitle_backup_code: Enter one of your backup codes (8 digits)
mfa.email_sent: A verification code has been sent by email
mfa.email_expired: The code has expired. Please resend it.
mfa.backup_code_hint: Spaces and hyphens are removed automatically. Each code can be used only once.
mfa.backup_remaining_regenerate: You are running low. Regenerate them from the security settings.
mfa.error_send_failed: Could not send the verification code. Please try again later.
mfa.error_resend_wait: Please wait a little before requesting another code
mfa.error_send_limit: The limit for sending codes has been reached. Please try again later.
mfa.error_attempts_exceeded: Too many attempts. Please log in again.
mfa.error_session_expired: Your verification has expired. Please log in again.
mfa.error_profile_failed: Failed to load your profile. Please reload the page.

recovery.title: Account recovery
recovery.subtitle: If you cannot access two-factor authentication, you can recover your account
recovery.request_description: We will send a recovery link to your registered email address.
recovery.confirm_description: You opened this from the email link. Press the button below to complete recovery.
recovery.confirm_failed_detail: The link has expired or has already been used. Please log in again to start over.
recovery.token_description: Open the link in the email we sent you. If you cannot open the link, enter the recovery token written in the email.
